Originally, there were many intelligent races on the world of Draenor, most powerful of which were the [[Orc]]s. The Orcs lived in a quiet, shamanistic society until power-hungry leaders made a pact with the [[Burning Legion]] which turned the Orcs into bloodthirsty conquerors. They decimated every other race on Draenor before the [[Dark Portal]] was opened, allowing most of the Orcs to leave for new lands to conquer.

Eventually, the power of the Dark Portal twisted and tore Draenor apart, leaving the barely-hospitable Outland. Some creatures managed to survive: some of the remaining Orcs, Ogres, and the [[Draenei]].

The [[Night Elf]] Demon [[Illidan]] and many of the [[Naga]] and [[Blood Elf|Blood Elves]] also fled to Draenor/Outland after their defeat in [[Northrend]] at the hands of [[Prince Arthas]]/The [[Lich King]].
